name: Shelly Decoupler 120V
summary: Optocoupler that lets 120VAC switches/sensors drive low-voltage DC inputs on Plus Uni, Add-on and RGBW devices.

f.inputs: 1 or 4 AC inputs (L) depending on variant
requires: Shelly Plus Uni, Plus Add-on, Plus RGBW PM or Pro RGBWW PM host

extra.use: connect AC-output PIR/microwave/hand-wave sensors or 120V wall switches to DC-input Shelly devices

gotchas: Passive accessory — does nothing without a host (Plus Uni, Plus Add-on, Plus RGBW PM, Pro RGBWW PM)
Signal-level output only (2.4mA) — it cannot switch any load
120V/60Hz version; the 230V version is a different part
Operating range 0-40°C — not for unheated outdoor enclosures
best_for: Using existing 120V wall switches or AC motion sensors as inputs to a 12/24V LED controller
not_for: use without a supported Shelly host
